subject: Request: Repurpose Tuesday demo to evening for CTO add
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
To: James Park <james@brightworks.co>, procurement@brightworks.co
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Repurpose Tuesday demo to evening for CTO add

Hi James —

Quick one: James mentioned his CTO may want to attend our Tuesday demo (originally 11:00–12:00 PT). They just flagged a travel conflict that prevents an earlier slot. Is there any chance we can move the session to an evening window (18:30–19:15 PT) so their CTO can join live?

If we go evening, I propose we compress the agenda to a 30–35 minute spotlight focused on the integration and latency/cost numbers, then offer a follow-up deep-dive for engineering. That gives the CTO the signal they typically want while preserving a path for the longer technical walkthrough.

Practical asks:
- Can BrightWorks commit to 18:30–19:15 PT on Tuesday?
- If yes, can procurement loop in the contract reviewer (I cc'd procurement) so we can surface any questions after the demo?

I've attached a compact agenda (agenda-v2.pdf) and a condensed runbook (demo-runbook-compact.docx) for a shorter format. Karthik/Monica — can you confirm we have coverage for the compressed demo (we may need Markus to cover fine-grained infra Qs if the CTO asks about runtime knobs)?

Thanks — will hold off sending a calendar update until I hear back.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: agenda-v2.pdf (1 page)
Attachment: demo-runbook-compact.docx (1 file)
From: James Park <james@brightworks.co>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightworks.co
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Repurpose Tuesday demo to evening for CTO add

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the heads up.

We had a late change: our CTO, Oliver Hayes, is flying in on Tuesday and can't make the mid-morning slot. He can absolutely join an evening window between 18:15–19:00 PT. He prefers shorter, executive-focused briefings. 30 minutes is perfect.

Procurement — can you confirm whether we should route NDA/terms discussion to a separate call or handle follow-up via email?

Two quick notes:
- Please make the agenda heavy on deployment topology and data isolation (our CTO will zero in on that).
- If you need a technical backup, Markus as a product owner sounds good to me.

Happy to lock this if you can send an updated invite.

Cheers,
James Park
Head of Platform Partnerships, BrightWorks
james@brightworks.co

Team — forwarding James' note. Summary/ops ask: BrightWorks is OK with an evening spot (they asked for 18:15–19:00 PT); they want a 30-minute exec-focused session that emphasizes deployment topology and data isolation.

Plan proposal from my side:
- Set a 30-minute slot 18:30–19:00 PT to give us some buffer for late travel.
- Agenda: 1) 5 min exec intro and business impact, 2) 12–15 min demo focused on topology & tenancy, 3) 8–10 min live Q&A (CTO heavy).
- Karthik — can you run the demo flow and keep the runbook condensed?
- Markus — can you own the infra isolation slides and be available for deep runtime questions?
- Monica — please prepare a 1-slide deployment/SLAs summary we can keep to the end if needed.

I will update the calendar after you confirm availability. If anyone can't make evening coverage, call it out and we'll propose an alternate: either bring in an additional backup (Dev/Product) or split into 20-min exec + follow-up tech session.

Thanks — Soojin

Operational notes:
- Markus will join as infra backup and open the runtime Q&A.
- Monica added a one-slide SLA summary and will be on the call.
- Procurement — James, if procurement wants a separate routing for contract questions, we can do a 15-minute follow-up next week; otherwise we will capture open items and route via DocuSign/HubSpot.

Soojin — sending you two attachments (agenda-v2.pdf, demo-runbook-compact.docx) in the invite. James — please confirm you received the update and that Oliver can make 18:30 PT.

Thanks everyone — Karthik
